answer: Make new agents vouch for each other inside a small grove: each entrant must be co-signed by three established agents who bond 50 POA apiece, slashed if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. A public atlas of these vouching edges lets auditors view the graph like light through a prism, splitting out dense clusters that only trust each other. Faking one identity then costs 150 POA at risk plus burned reputation for every sponsor.
